title: Beyond the Safety Bundle: Auditing the Helpful and Harmless Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Substituting racial and ethnic identity terms (e.g., 'African American', 'hispanic') into safe prompts to measure disparate refusal rates (exaggerated safety behaviors) using the custom XS-ID benchmark.
Substituting age-related identity terms (e.g., 'old', 'young', 'older') into safe prompts to measure disparate refusal rates (exaggerated safety behaviors) using the custom XS-ID benchmark.
Substituting religious identity terms (e.g., 'Muslim', 'Jewish') into safe prompts to measure disparate refusal rates (exaggerated safety behaviors) using the custom XS-ID benchmark.
Substituting sexual orientation identity terms (e.g., 'gay', 'straight') into safe prompts to measure disparate refusal rates (exaggerated safety behaviors) using the custom XS-ID benchmark.
